text:
Devon: Quick async standup — yesterday: rolled back model-router canary due to a 5xx spike at ~02:15, created rollback-runbook ticket INF-500. Patched flaky healthcheckLambda and verified KV-cache invalidation in staging.

Devon: Blockers: alert noise from BackoffSpike still noisy during bursts, need to tune Prom rule and add debounce. Also seeing a small p90 latency blip on dedicated nodes after rollback.

Devon: Today: adjust alert thresholds, open PR to debounce alerts, pair with Sara on runbook edits, triage any oncall escalations. cc @Lindsey @Peter

Sara: Saw the 5xxs — looks like Redis connection saturation during the canary. I bumped connection pool size temporarily and started a small autoscale job. Will follow up with a config PR.

Lindsey: I can take the runbook edits. Which runbook is canonical for backoff/failed-requests?

Devon: It's the "service-backoffs" runbook under infra/runbooks. Quick snippet of the alert rule below — thinking to loosen it a bit and add rate()/avg: 

```yaml
- alert: BackoffSpike
  expr: increase(service_backoffs_total[5m]) > 50
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

Devon: My proposal: change `for` to 5m, raise threshold to 100 and use `avg_over_time` or `rate()` to reduce flapping. Also add an annotation with recent samples.

Peter: +1 to using `rate()` and averaging. Also recommend changing the severity to `ticket` for small sustained spikes and keep `page` for much larger bursts.

Devon: Filed INF-512 with details and linked PR for debounce logic. CCing oncall-bot to create incident record.

oncall-bot: New incident INF-512 opened by Devon. Priority: P3. Assigned: Lindsey. https://incidents/internal/INF-512

Lindsey: Picking up INF-512. I'll add a temporary suppression window for nightly batch jobs (03:00-04:30 UTC) and update the runbook with triage steps. ETA ~2h.

Sara: Pushed PR #211 with autoscale + pool-size change for Redis; tests passing in CI. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/211

Peter: Quick CR ping — Devon, can you review PR #214 (debounce decorator) when you have a moment?

Devon: Will review after lunch. Also continuing to investigate the p90 latency regression on dedicated nodes — suspecting KV-cache eviction policy after rollback.

Sara: Noted. I added a telemetry query to the ticket to track eviction rate: `sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (node)`

Peter: :thumbsup:

Lindsey: Small follow-up — can we add an alert condition to silence BackoffSpike during our scheduled nightly batch (03:00-04:30 UTC)? I'll add that to INF-512 and request a temporary config change.

Devon: Yes, please. Also added a tiny script to reproduce the backoff locally if you want to test: 

```bash
# simulate backoff load
python scripts/simulate_backoff.py --rate 200 --duration 300
```

Devon: Anything else?

Sara: Nothing more from infra side.

Peter: Just the CR reminder.

Devon: Ok will post another update when runbook edits + PRs merge. Thanks team :raised_hands:
